fullPassage: Dr. Viktor Emil Frankl was an Austrian psychiatrist who thought that feeling emotional pain was a natural part of life, and that humans have the ability to choose how to respond to situations. But most importantly, he believed that people's main motivation in life is the search for meaning. According to Frankl, in order to find this meaning in their lives, people have to change their attitude toward unavoidable suffering. For example, Frankl was helping a man who was severely depressed after his wife's death. He asked the man to think about what would have happened if he had died first and his wife had been forced to live without him. The man realized his own grief and pain meant that his wife did not have to experience what he was going through. This helped end his depression.

det.korean: feel(동사: 느끼다) → feeling(동명사: 느끼는 것). 주어 자리의 동명사
det.analysis: feel을 동명사 feeling으로 변환. '감정적 고통을 느끼는 것(Feeling)은' 삶의 자연스러운 부분이다 — 주어 자리에 동명사(-ing)가 필요
det.tip: 주어 자리 '~하는 것' → 동명사(-ing). feeling emotional pain was ~

questions.passage: He asked the man to think about what would have happened if his wife had been __________ (force) to live without him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: force(동사: 강요하다) → forced(과거분사). had been forced = 수동태(be + p.p.)
det.analysis: force를 과거분사 forced로 변환. 'his wife had been forced to live'는 '그의 아내가 살도록 강요당했다'는 수동태(had been + p.p.) 구문 — 강요를 '당하는' 것이므로 수동
det.tip: had been _____ → 수동태(be + p.p.) → forced

questions.passage: Dr. Viktor Emil Frankl was an Austrian psychiatrist who thought that feeling emotional pain was a natural part of life, and that humans have the ability to choose how to respond to situations. But most importantly, he believed that people's main motivation in life is __________. According to Frankl, in order to find this meaning in their lives, people have to change their attitude toward unavoidable suffering. For example, Frankl was helping a man who was severely depressed after his wife's death. He asked the man to think about what would have happened if he had died first and his wife had been forced to live without him. The man realized his own grief and pain meant that his wife did not have to experience what he was going through. This helped end his depression.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: the fear of death=죽음의 두려움 / the search for meaning=의미의 추구 / the love of money=돈에 대한 사랑 / the need for power=권력의 필요
det.analysis:
① the fear of death: 죽음의 두려움 — 뒤 문장(의미 찾기)과 연결 안 됨
② the search for meaning: 삶의 주된 동기는 '의미의 추구'이고, 뒤에서 이 의미를 찾는 방법을 설명 ←정답
③ the love of money: 돈에 대한 사랑 — 문맥 부적절
④ the need for power: 권력의 필요 — 문맥 부적절
det.tip: 뒤 문장 'in order to find this meaning'의 this meaning이 단서 → the search for meaning

questions.passage: Dr. Viktor Emil Frankl was an Austrian psychiatrist who thought that feeling emotional pain was a natural part of life, and that humans have the ability to choose how to respond to situations. But most importantly, he believed that people's main motivation in life is the search for meaning. According to Frankl, in order to find this meaning in their lives, people have to __________ toward unavoidable suffering. For example, Frankl was helping a man who was severely depressed after his wife's death. He asked the man to think about what would have happened if he had died first and his wife had been forced to live without him. The man realized his own grief and pain meant that his wife did not have to experience what he was going through. This helped end his depression.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: forget their memories=기억을 잊다 / hide their emotions=감정을 숨기다 / change their attitude=태도를 바꾸다 / increase their income=수입을 늘리다
det.analysis:
① forget their memories: 기억을 잊다 — 고통을 대하는 방식과 다름
② hide their emotions: 감정을 숨기다 — 본문 취지와 다름
③ change their attitude: 의미를 찾으려면 피할 수 없는 고통에 대한 '태도를 바꿔야' 한다 ←정답
④ increase their income: 수입을 늘리다 — 문맥 무관
det.tip: toward unavoidable suffering(피할 수 없는 고통에 대해) + Frankl의 핵심 주장 → change their attitude
